en.headline: Manpower shortfall projected at 130,000 by 2028 as AI eases demand
en.dek: Labour and Welfare Bureau mid-term update narrows earlier forecast of 180,000; clerical roles face surplus while construction, healthcare and tech remain tight.
body: Hong Kong's overall manpower shortage is projected to narrow to about 130,000 workers by 2028, down from an earlier forecast of 180,000, according to a mid-term update released by the Labour and Welfare Bureau on Tuesday.

The improvement reflects talent admission and labour importation measures together with slower demand growth from economic restructuring and wider use of artificial intelligence. Without those measures the shortfall would widen to around 300,000 as the labour force ages. Construction is expected to face the largest gap of 30,000 to 40,000, followed by city operations, healthcare and innovation and technology.

By occupation, skilled technical workers and service and sales staff account for about 60 per cent of the remaining shortage. Clerical support roles are projected to record a surplus of 25,000 to 30,000 by 2028 as firms expand AI for routine administration. Entry-level vacancies suitable for fresh graduates have already fallen by about 60 per cent compared with 2022.

zh.headline: 人力推算2028年短缺收窄至13萬人 AI致文書職位過剩
zh.dek: 勞福局中期更新顯示整體缺口由上次推算18萬人收窄，建造、醫療及創科仍緊張，文書支援人員料過剩2.5萬至3萬人。
body: 勞工及福利局周二公布最新「人力推算中期更新」報告，推算至2028年本港整體人力短缺約13萬人，較上次推算約18萬人有所收窄。
改善受惠於過去三年招攬人才及輸入勞工措施，加上經濟轉型及人工智能應用減慢人手需求增長。若無輸入措施，勞動人口老化將令短缺擴大至約30萬人。選定產業中，建造業缺口最大，達3萬至4萬人，其次為城市運作、醫療保健及創新科技。
按職業組別，熟練技術人員及服務銷售人員佔整體缺口約六成。隨企業擴大AI處理常規行政工作，文書支援人員於2028年料出現約2.5萬至3萬人過剩。應屆畢業生合適空缺較2022年已銳減約六成。
